title: Alternating sum of a palindromic sequence of length 2d+1
statement:
Let $d\in\mathbf Z_{\geq0}$ and let $b_0,b_1,\ldots,b_{2d}$ be integers with $b_i=b_{2d-i}$ for every integer $i$ with $0\leq i\leq2d$. Put

$$
\chi=\sum_{i=0}^{2d}(-1)^ib_i\in\mathbf Z.
$$

Then

$$
\chi=2\sum_{i=0}^{d-1}(-1)^ib_i+(-1)^db_d ,
$$

so in particular the integer $\chi-b_d$ is even.
